screens.name: Start Menu
screens.keybind: auto at boot (skipped with --temp); Up/Down navigate, Enter/Space select, mouse click, ESC=autosave+quit
screens.purpose: Boot screen with 4 options: New World / Load World / Load Default Save / Temporary World; shows save-file count

screens.name: Pause Menu
screens.keybind: ESC (when no other UI open); Up/Down, Enter/Space select, ESC returns
screens.purpose: 3 options: Return to game / Save & Exit (disabled in temp world) / Exit without saving; dim backdrop, drawn last over everything

screens.name: Loading Screen (world gen)
screens.keybind: none (automatic after start-menu selection)
screens.purpose: Stage name + progress fraction + flavor line while WorldSystem.initialize_world() runs

screens.name: Class Selection (mandatory modal)
screens.keybind: auto on new character; ESC blocked with 'Choose a class to continue' notification; mouse click to pick
screens.purpose: Pick 1 of 6 starting classes; includes class hover tooltip; suppresses all other menu rendering while open

screens.name: Stats / Character Menu
screens.keybind: C toggle; C or ESC close
screens.purpose: 3 columns: 6 stats with +1 allocation buttons (when unallocated points), TITLES list (last 8, tier-colored, bonus descriptions), PROGRESS bars toward next titles. NOTE: this IS the title UI — no separate title-selection screen exists

screens.name: Equipment Menu
screens.keybind: E toggle; ESC close
screens.purpose: 8-slot equipment panel with click-to-equip/unequip rects + equipment tooltip

screens.name: Skills Menu
screens.keybind: K toggle; ESC close; wheel=scroll learned, Shift+wheel=scroll available
screens.purpose: Hotbar assignment rects + learned-skills list + available/learnable skills list

screens.name: Encyclopedia
screens.keybind: L toggle; ESC close; wheel scroll (20px/notch)
screens.purpose: Tabbed reference browser (encyclopedia_tab_rects) for discovered content

screens.name: World Map
screens.keybind: M toggle (centers on player); wheel=zoom, left-drag=pan, P=place waypoint while open; ESC close
screens.purpose: Fullscreen chunk map with waypoints, waypoint click rects + action rects; there is NO minimap — this is the only map

screens.name: Waypoint Rename dialog (map sub-mode)
screens.keybind: typed text (max len from config), Enter/KP_Enter confirm, ESC cancel, Backspace delete; blocks all other keys
screens.purpose: Inline text entry to rename a waypoint slot on the map

screens.name: Waypoint Delete confirmation (map sub-mode)
screens.keybind: Enter/KP_Enter confirm delete, ESC cancel; blocks all other keys
screens.purpose: Confirm dialog before deleting a waypoint

screens.name: Quest Log overlay
screens.keybind: J toggle
screens.purpose: Lists active quests + objectives + progress with per-quest Abandon buttons (rects returned for click dispatch)

screens.name: NPC Dialogue
screens.keybind: F near NPC (when not in dungeon); F or ESC close
screens.purpose: NPC name header, dialogue lines, quest-offer buttons, 'Turn In Quest' button (highest priority when quest complete)

screens.name: Crafting Station UI (recipe browser)
screens.keybind: left-click station in range to open; ESC close; wheel scrolls grouped recipe list
screens.purpose: Grouped recipe list (headers by type), selected-recipe placement grid, INVENT button rect that launches interactive crafting

screens.name: Interactive Crafting / INVENT UI
screens.keybind: opened via INVENT button; ESC close; wheel scrolls material palette; right-click removes placed materials
screens.purpose: Free-form material placement grid + material palette + buttons for classifier-validated invented items; includes narrative text-input sub-mode (typed prose max 200 chars, Enter submit, ESC cancel)

screens.name: Smithing Minigame
screens.keybind: Space = fan bellows; double-ESC (within 1.5s) abandons craft with materials lost
screens.purpose: Modal craft minigame rendered on top of everything

screens.name: Alchemy Minigame
screens.keybind: C = chain, S = stabilize; double-ESC abandon
screens.purpose: Modal sequence-based craft minigame

screens.name: Refining Minigame
screens.keybind: Space = attempt; double-ESC abandon
screens.purpose: Modal timing-based craft minigame

screens.name: Engineering Minigame
screens.keybind: mouse clicks only (buttons + rotation-pipe / sliding-tile / logic-switch puzzles); double-ESC abandon
screens.purpose: Modal puzzle craft minigame with 3 puzzle sub-renderers

screens.name: Adornments/Enchanting Minigame
screens.keybind: mouse: betting-phase slider drag (wheel_slider_rect) + clicks; double-ESC abandon
screens.purpose: Betting-wheel enchant minigame (minigame_type 'adornments' routes to _render_enchanting_minigame)

screens.name: Fishing Minigame
screens.keybind: per-minigame input; double-ESC abandon
screens.purpose: Modal fishing minigame

screens.name: Enchantment Target-Selection UI
screens.keybind: ESC cancel; wheel scrolls compatible-item list (~5 visible); mouse click to choose
screens.purpose: After enchant craft: pick which compatible item receives the enchantment; rendered on top of other menus

screens.name: Dungeon Chest UI
screens.keybind: click chest in dungeon to toggle; ESC close
screens.purpose: Loot chest with per-item click rects (only renders while in dungeon)

screens.name: Spawn Storage Chest UI
screens.keybind: click spawn chest to toggle; ESC close
screens.purpose: Persistent home-base storage with item click rects

screens.name: Death Chest UI
screens.keybind: click own death chest in world (range-checked); click item = retrieve, click outside = close
screens.purpose: Retrieve items dropped on death (rich_contents preserves full item state); chest auto-removes when emptied. NOTE: there is NO death screen — death = instant respawn at spawn + notification + chest drop

screens.name: LLM Generation Blocking Overlay
screens.keybind: blocks ALL input except ESC = cancel generation (materials not consumed)
screens.purpose: Full-screen animated overlay while Claude generates an invented item; separate small corner spinner for classifier ops

screens.name: WES Observability Overlay
screens.keybind: F12 toggle
screens.purpose: Live ring buffer of WMS->WNS->WES->Registry->Reload pipeline events for Living World debugging

screens.name: Debug toggles F1-F5/F7/F10 + Shift+F8
screens.keybind: F1 infinite resources+max level pts, F2 learn all skills, F3 all titles, F4 max level/stats, F5 keep-inventory, F7 infinite durability, F10 automated test suite, Shift+F8 biome debug print
screens.purpose: Toggleable debug cheats with save/restore of original state; F1 also enables hitbox debug rendering

screens.name: Save/Load/Display utility keys
screens.keybind: F6 timestamped quick-save; F9 load autosave / Shift+F9 load default save; F11 fullscreen toggle
screens.purpose: Player-facing persistence + display controls (no settings menu exists — F11 is the only display setting)

screens.name: Dungeon Enter/Exit
screens.keybind: click dungeon entrance in range (normal path); double-tap F within 0.5s = quick exit; F8 = debug enter/exit
screens.purpose: Transition into wave-based dungeon world; entrance carries pre-rolled rarity

hud_elements: Right-side CHARACTER INFO panel (always visible, UI_PANEL_WIDTH strip): debug-mode indicator, class name+icon, position, current chunk name colored by danger level (peaceful/dangerous/rare/water), level + unallocated-points alert, XP/next-level, selected tool + durability + effectiveness, last-3 titles with icons, static CONTROLS key list (renderer.py:3014-3171; called game_engine.py:8646)
HP bar (300x25 scaled) with numeric text + shield-blocking indicator when char.is_blocking (renderer.py:3173-3187)
Mana bar below HP (renderer.py:3187; drawn at renderer.py:3095)
Active buffs list under mana bar (renderer.py:3196; called renderer.py:3099)

Bottom inventory panel (always visible, no toggle key): weight bar with green->red encumbrance coloring + current/max text, equipped tool slots (axe/pickaxe) with hover highlight, 30-slot item grid with drag-and-drop and item tooltips (renderer.py:4965-5024,5148,5229; called game_engine.py:8647)

Skill hotbar, 5 slots bottom-center of viewport: key numbers 1-5, skill icons (initials fallback), cooldown dark overlay + seconds countdown, mana cost colored by affordability, hover tooltip (renderer.py:3240-3318; called game_engine.py:8650)
Notifications feed (colored timed messages, also drawn over start menu) (renderer.py:4921; game_engine.py:8587,8652)
Day/night tint overlay from time phase + progress (renderer.py:2954; game_engine.py:8640-8642)
Enemy overhead health bars with tier prefix 'T{n}' or 'BOSS' label + boss glow color — NO separate top-screen boss bar (renderer.py:1411-1415,1642-1653; dungeon variant 2427-2445)
Dungeon HUD panel: 'Wave X/Y' indicator + progress (renderer.py:2490-2527)
Damage numbers (classic list + enhanced DamageNumberManager) and enemy death fade/shrink effects (game_engine.py:378-393,8604-8605,8635)
Screen shake camera offset during action combat, reset before UI draw (game_engine.py:8597-8601,8637-8638)

Deferred tooltip system drawn LAST above all modals: item/equipment/tool/class/generic tooltips funneled through render_pending_tooltip (renderer.py:5229,6836,6978,7054,7085,7704; game_engine.py:8835-8836)
Corner loading spinner for classifier operations (non-blocking variant of the LLM overlay) (renderer.py:7975-7977)
notes: ESC close-priority chain (single ESC handler, port must preserve order): enchant selection > interactive crafting > dungeon chest > spawn chest > crafting UI > stats > equipment > skills > encyclopedia > map > class selection (blocked, shows notification) > NPC dialogue > else open pause menu (game_engine.py:805-853)

C/E/K/L/M/J overlay panels are mutually exclusive via _close_other_overlay_panels; opening one closes the others through their own toggle methods so scroll-reset and menu-time stats stay correct (game_engine.py:7508-7525,862,872,882,892,906,1323)

Render order contract: world/dungeon -> day/night -> UI panel -> inventory panel -> hotbar -> notifications -> WES overlay -> quest log -> chests -> class selection (suppresses all other menus when open) -> crafting/stats/skills/equipment/encyclopedia/map/dialogue/enchant-select -> minigame (on top of EVERYTHING) -> LLM loading indicator -> deferred tooltips -> pause menu LAST (game_engine.py:8578-8847)
Minigame abandon requires double-ESC within 1.5s (materials-lost warning); dungeon quick-exit requires double-F within 0.5s — both intentional anti-accident idioms (game_engine.py:709-726,918-926)

No death screen: player death respawns instantly at world spawn (dungeon death: chest spawns at dungeon entrance) with notification only (entities/character.py:1880-1946). No minimap. No settings/options menu. No dedicated boss health bar.

Combat/movement (non-menu) keys a port needs: WASD move, TAB switch tool, left-click harvest/interact/attack (held = continuous mainhand), right-click hold = shield block, X hold = offhand attack or shield block, Shift+right-click = use consumable, Q drop 1 / Shift+Q drop stack, Space = dodge roll with i-frames (action combat), 1-5 = skills aimed at mouse world position (game_engine.py:854-1015,1464-1476,8448-8479)

Mouse-wheel is context-routed by hover rect, in priority order: map zoom > enchant-select scroll > interactive-crafting palette > recipe list > encyclopedia > skills menu (Shift+wheel = available skills) (game_engine.py:1364-1462)
LLM overlay swallows all events except ESC-cancel while generation runs — port must replicate this input lock (game_engine.py:645-660)

Text-input modes (narrative INVENT prose max 200 chars, waypoint rename max from MapWaypointConfig) consume printable unicode chars with Backspace/Enter/ESC — Godot port needs equivalent text capture (game_engine.py:744-767,780-803)
Start menu ESC performs autosave-then-quit when a character exists and world is not temporary (game_engine.py:688-704)
Minigame input routing is by minigame_type string: smithing/alchemy/refining/engineering/adornments/fishing; 'adornments' renders via _render_enchanting_minigame (game_engine.py:8857-8868)
